answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when peers prove duplicate identities, so creating many fake agents means locking real value per identity. A newcomer starts with a small opal-tier limit and earns higher limits only after a history of verified work, like nectar gathered slowly rather than claimed at once. Attackers then face a choice: pay the stake for every sable-shadow identity or stay small, and the cost grows linearly with each fake while honest agents pay once and keep their reputation.
